name: line-stroke-draw
title: SVG Stroke Draw
description: Một đường SVG tự vẽ từ đầu tới cuối bằng cách rút dần khoảng lệch của nét đứt.

moworks.author: takayu

options.eraseAt: s after the start to erase forward in 0.5 s (null: stay drawn)

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio svg-stroke-draw, written here): pathLength = 1, stroke-dasharray 1, dashoffset 1 -> 0 over 1100 ms easeOutCubic. Site card (sh-draw): a two-segment cubic curve, 5 px round-cap stroke, draws over 1.4 s ease-in-out from 0.2 s, holds, then erases forward (offset 0 -> -1) over 0.5 s from 2.2 s; 2.8 s loop. Params: duration (1.1 s) · ease (power2.out) · width: độ dày nét.
